failure_summary.description: For terse clues, agents repeated the prompt, gave a broad category, answered True, or chose a related term despite existing guidance to identify and verify the requested answer.
Answers identified the intended entity but differed from the expected form in title spelling, name parts, or included/omitted wording.

patch.reasoning: The current skill already covers implicit clue interpretation, answer-slot verification, concise granularity, and context-supported conventional forms. These failures reflect not following those rules or exact-match surface-form differences, so additional guidance would duplicate existing content.
